name: SonarScanner CLI
description: Install the SonarScanner CLI for running SonarQube Server / SonarQube Cloud analysis locally.

version.description: Version of SonarScanner CLI to install (e.g. '8.1.0.6389')

includeJre.description: Download the platform-specific bundle with a bundled JRE. When false, downloads the generic zip and a JRE must be installed separately.
